decisions.reason: The custom in-ear earmold is part of the firm's core hearing-care business, costs little to keep on offer, and benefits from its digital production know-how.
The individual EARsleeve serves the universal in-ear hearing-system segment with established custom-fit capabilities and has a dedicated page, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Vacuum thermoforming units are long-lived equipment that drive the sale of the firm's foil materials, so they typically stay on the market for years.

The orthopedic shoe last lies outside the firm's dental and hearing core, which raises the risk of withdrawal, but it reuses digital manufacturing know-how and was only launched in 2024, so it gets more time to prove itself.
A post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing resins and digital workflow, making it a natural and inexpensive part of its integrated system offer.
